replacements.after:
def compose(definitions, helpers, payload, advert, progress, diagnostic, window):
    old = fixed(OLD_PHONE_CARRIER)
    fixed(OLD_PHONE_RUNNER)
    base = bounded(definitions.make_source(helpers, INPUTS, payload, False))
    phone = bounded(progress.make_source(definitions, advert, diagnostic, helpers, INPUTS, payload))
    old_runner = runner_block(definitions, helpers, OLD_PHONE_RUNNER)
    current_runner = runner_block(definitions, helpers, definitions.RUNNER)
    old_roles, current_roles = assignment_region(old, 'ARTIFACT_ROWS'), assignment_region(base, 'ARTIFACT_ROWS')
    need(old.count(old_runner) == old.count(old_roles) == phone.count(current_runner) ==
         phone.count(current_roles) == 1, 'phone_graph_regions_unique')
    expected = old.replace(old_runner, current_runner, 1).replace(old_roles, current_roles, 1)
    inverse = phone.replace(current_roles, old_roles, 1).replace(current_runner, old_runner, 1)
    need(phone == expected and inverse == old, 'phone_current_graph_complete_byte_inverse')
    need(ast.dump(ast.parse(phone.decode('ascii'), feature_version=(3, 5)), include_attributes=False) ==
         ast.dump(ast.parse(expected.decode('ascii'), feature_version=(3, 5)), include_attributes=False) and
         ast.dump(ast.parse(inverse.decode('ascii'), feature_version=(3, 5)), include_attributes=False) ==
         ast.dump(ast.parse(old.decode('ascii'), feature_version=(3, 5)), include_attributes=False),
         'phone_current_graph_complete_ast_inverse')
    need(definitions.RUNNER[1:] == (79279,
        '68573f0c9053db3df42f71647d9765a6af9bda56f4913daeef52b79e907f1894'),
        'ordinary_proc_freezer_runner')
    anchor = b'detail=fixed_error_details(smoke._RETAINED.failures)\n'
    addition = b'retained=smoke._RETAINED\n' + window.PROJECTION
    need(phone.count(anchor) == 1, 'window_projection_anchor')
    program = bounded(phone.replace(anchor, addition+anchor, 1))
    projected_inverse = program.replace(addition+anchor, anchor, 1)
    need(program.count(current_runner) == program.count(addition+anchor) == 1 and
         projected_inverse == phone and assignment_region(program, 'ARTIFACT_ROWS') == current_roles,
         'window_scalar_complete_carrier_inverse_runtime75_unchanged')
    need(ast.dump(ast.parse(projected_inverse.decode('ascii'), feature_version=(3, 5)),
         include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(ast.parse(phone.decode('ascii'), feature_version=(3, 5)),
         include_attributes=False), 'window_scalar_complete_ast_inverse')
    return base, phone, program
